name: SeaCoast Hurricane Shutters
headline: Motorized hurricane shutters for Florida storms.
intro: Premium motorized roll-down shutters for homes and businesses, installed across Daytona and Volusia County.
about: SeaCoast Hurricane Shutters specialises in premium motorized roll-down shutters designed to protect homes and businesses from Florida's toughest storms. The team brings over twenty years of experience, and every installation is backed by outstanding craftsmanship and personalised customer service.
ctaHeadline: Get a quote for your property.
ctaCopy: Call or email to talk through your windows, openings and colour choice, and we will put a personalised quote together.
footerLine: Motorized hurricane shutters for Daytona and Volusia County.
seoTitle: SeaCoast Hurricane Shutters | Daytona Beach, FL
seoDescription: Motorized roll-down hurricane shutters for homes and businesses in Daytona and Volusia County, Florida. Almond, white, beige or bronze, with a five-year warranty.

services.title: Motorized roll-down shutters
services.description: Premium roll-down hurricane shutters for homes and businesses, built for Florida's storm season.

services.title: Motorized operation
services.description: Motorization means the shutters close at the touch of a button, without the effort of manual installation.

services.title: Four colour options
services.description: Almond, white, beige and bronze, so the shutters match the look of your home while still doing their job.

services.title: Five-year parts warranty
services.description: Every shutter we sell carries a five-year parts warranty.
